body.name: mathcal_D_n
body.def: When \(h_n=2^{-J}\), set \(r_j=2^jh_n\) and \(M_j=\lceil\sqrt{r_j}/h_n\rceil\) for \(j=0,\ldots,J-1\). For \(k=0,\ldots,M_j-1\), let \(D_{j,k}=[r_j+kr_j/M_j,r_j+(k+1)r_j/M_j)\), except that \(D_{J-1,M_{J-1}-1}\) includes its right endpoint \(1\). The disjoint collection \(\mathcal D_n=\{D_{j,k}:0\leq j<J,0\leq k<M_j\}\) partitions \([h_n,1]\).
